assertions.text: Output is a valid YAML document
Every dbt task uses the DBT_CORE integration
Every dbt task runs the DBT_CORE_EXECUTE job
package_manager is one of the valid Orchestra enum values (PIP, POETRY, UV)

parameters.project_dir is explicitly set (a subdirectory path, or null when the project sits at the repo root) on every DBT_CORE task rather than omitted, since DbtProject(project_dir=...) is a real task parameter, not connection config

The dbt project's Git repository URL/branch and the warehouse credentials live on the DBT_CORE connection, never hardcoded as literal parameter values — Orchestra pulls the dbt project from the connected Git repo and compiles the manifest itself, so no manifest.json is shipped

Multiple @dbt_assets or sequential dbt.cli([...]) invocations against the same dbt project are consolidated into a single DBT_CORE_EXECUTE task's semicolon-joined commands string, not split into one task per asset/model
commands never pass --profiles-dir or a literal profile/target credential; profiles.yml-managed warehouse credentials are left entirely to the Orchestra dbt Core connection
